text:
When I was at sea, of the sea was

this unhurried pain.

Give me your mouth now:

I want to eat it with your smile.


When I was in heaven, heavenly was

this urgent pain.

Give me your soul now:

I want to sink my teeth into it.


Give me nothing, love, give me nothing:

I take you in the wind,

I take you from the stream of shadow,

from the turning of light and silence,


from the skin of things

and the blood with which I climb into time.

You are a fountain whether you want to be or not

and I am the thirsty one.


Don't talk to me, if you like, don't touch me,

don't know me anymore, I no longer exist.

I am only the life that hounds you

and you are the death I resist.

translation.title: When I Was at Sea
